name.value: Island View Beach Regional Park Campground

description.value: Sandy beach campground on the Saanich Peninsula east of Sidney, set along a broad tidal shore with views across Haro Strait toward the Gulf Islands; paved access makes it easy to reach by bike, and the fee-required sites draw families and beach campers through the summer season.

raw_osm.name: Island View Beach Regional Park Campground
raw_osm.note: Fee: Tent-$15/night, RV-$20/night. Open: May long weekend to September long weekend. 18- RV sites, 24 treed tent sites.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content retrieved consists almost entirely of CRD site navigation menus with no campground-specific detail, so OSM tags serve as the primary evidence source. OSM confirms drinking_water=yes, tents=yes, reservation=no, and the OSM note field specifies 24 treed tent sites, 18 RV sites, and seasonal operation. No hiker/biker-specific pricing or amenities beyond water are documented in either source.
concerns: Website content fetched was almost entirely site navigation with no campground-specific detail rendered; amenities beyond OSM tags cannot be verified from the website.
Campground is seasonal (May long weekend to September long weekend per OSM note); directory entry should reflect seasonal availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating regional park campground with tent sites, potable water, and no-reservation access — well suited to touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM note records 24 treed tent sites and 18 RV/caravan sites. First-come, first-served only.
